title: Superwhisper Capture Metadata (meta.json)
description: Shape of the meta.json file Superwhisper writes per recording. FIRST VERSION, based on the plan document's description (exact 'Idea Inbox' mode field, non-empty transcript and first-pass-note fields, recorded per capture) rather than a real Superwhisper export, since no real Superwhisper output has been made available to compare against yet. Field names and the additionalProperties:true tolerance are a deliberate best guess and are expected to be revised once real output is inspected. The exact-mode business rule ('mode' must equal "Idea Inbox" for this pipeline to process the recording) is intentionally NOT enforced by this schema as a `const`/`enum` restriction -- Superwhisper supports many modes, and rejecting the wrong ones is an intake-workflow business rule (see local-voice-inbox-mvp-implementation-plan.md), not a structural-validity concern. A meta.json with mode: "Quick Capture" is still a structurally valid meta.json.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was produced against.

source_id.description: Stable identifier for this recording/capture (e.g. Superwhisper recording UUID or folder name). Used downstream as part of the idempotency key.

mode.description: Superwhisper capture mode name as configured by the user, e.g. "Idea Inbox". The intake workflow requires an exact match against "Idea Inbox"; other values are structurally valid but must be rejected by the workflow, not this schema.

captured_at.description: Timestamp the recording was captured, ISO 8601.

transcript.description: Raw speech-to-text transcript. Must be non-empty for the recording to be processed.

first_pass_note.description: Superwhisper's own first-pass cleanup/summary note produced at capture time. Must be non-empty for the recording to be processed.

language.description: Detected or configured transcription language, e.g. "en".

device.description: Recording device or app/version identifier, free text.
